description:
The adapters of mc-extension-core: the loader that reads every
        META-INF/mindconnect/extension.json on the classpath, the audit that
        names the jars bringing tools without one, the file and in-memory
        stores of a namespace's activation decisions, the tool-registry overlay
        that hides a switched-off extension's tools, and the Spring
        auto-configuration that wires it all. The Postgres store is
        mc-extension-pg.
